recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is recommended for FHIR-13062 unless a future CDS/workflow decision reopens whether RequestOrchestration should carry a redundant aggregate status.
issue_request: FHIR-13062 is a Published/Persuasive CDS change request, raised and applied for DSTU2, asking that RequestGroup gain a status element with codes drawn directly from the Request.status pattern and that a status search parameter be defined.
initial_application: Jira records Bryn Rhodes's application comment as SVN 11649. Git history maps that revision to commit 3369ed722701f69defe2ff260c37d7a62204dfdc, which added RequestGroup.status, the RequestStatus binding, status examples, and the status search parameter to the then-authoritative spreadsheet/status sources. Later source conversion commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried the applied element and search parameter into XML source.
additional_context: FHIR-24619 later renamed RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration. Current source/fhir.ini has an active requestorchestration=RequestOrchestration resource entry and a RequestGroup=@RequestOrchestration migration alias, and rename commit 46bea37a00e63d1ace04a5f322614c6d0815f500 preserved the status element and status search parameter under the new resource name. Related FHIR-13758 rejected adding RequestGroup.action.status and did not reverse the root status decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current RequestOrchestration StructureDefinition defines RequestOrchestration.status as 1..1 code, modifier, summary, required-bound to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/request-status, and mapped to Request.status; the current RequestOrchestration search-parameter bundle defines code status with expression RequestOrchestration.status.

related_jiras.note: Renamed RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration and preserved the status element/search parameter under the new resource name.
Rejected adding RequestGroup.action.status, supporting that no additional action-level status should be added while leaving the root status intact.
